label: ZTE NetBox MC7010 outdoor 5G CPE
description: ZTE NetBox outdoor 5G CPE (Snapdragon X55M, sub-6 NSA/SA) rated 3.8 Gbps down / 331 Mbps up with LTE Cat 22/20 fallback. A single 2.5 Gigabit RJ45 port carries the data and the standard PoE feed; the 5G uplink is carried as the Ethernet-class interface wan5g.
